% A document with lists that \@starttoc reads under the document's own
% extension, beside the stale list files of an earlier build with other
% packages. tex4ht reads such a list from the build folder, and from the
% document's folder when the build folder has none, so a stale file there
% stops the build with LaTeX errors. Each list's stale file comes from
% another earlier build:
% - test-staleaux-toc.exp (tocloft \newlistof): hyperref's four-argument
%   \contentsline with hyperref's \texorpdfstring, which this build does
%   not load;
% - test-staleaux-toc.rmk (tocloft \newlistof with a [section] counter): a
%   PDF build without hyperref: three three-argument \contentsline lines,
%   which tex4ht's four-argument \contentsline reads past the end of the
%   file;
% - test-staleaux-toc.loe (thmtools \listoftheorems): a file that starts
%   with \addvspace, then one three-argument line with babel's
%   \foreignlanguage;
% - test-staleaux-toc.box (tcolorbox list inside=box): a build with
%   biblatex, whose \boolfalse and \defcounter lines come before the first
%   \contentsline;
% - test-staleaux-toc.tdo (todonotes \listoftodos): an entry with babel's
%   \foreignlanguage;
% - test-staleaux-toc.loa (algorithm2e \listofalgorithms): hyperref's
%   four-argument line with amssymb's \mathbb, which this build does not
%   load.
% The stale .toc, .lof, .lot, listings' .lol, and newfloat's .lop are
% guards: tex4ht sends these lists through the .4ct, so the build reads
% them neither before nor after the fix. Every stale file stays as it is.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\usepackage{thmtools}
\usepackage{tcolorbox}
\usepackage{todonotes}
\usepackage[ruled]{algorithm2e}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage{newfloat}
\newlistof{example}{exp}{Examples}
\newcommand{\example}[1]{\refstepcounter{example}\par\noindent Example~\theexample: #1%
  \addcontentsline{exp}{example}{\protect\numberline{\theexample}#1}\par}
\newlistof[section]{remark}{rmk}{Remarks}
\newcommand{\remark}[1]{\refstepcounter{remark}\par\noindent Remark~\theremark: #1%
  \addcontentsline{rmk}{remark}{\protect\numberline{\theremark}#1}\par}
\declaretheorem{theorem}
\newtcolorbox[list inside=box]{mybox}[1]{title=#1}
\DeclareFloatingEnvironment[fileext=lop]{program}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\listoffigures
\listoftables
\lstlistoflistings
\listofprograms
\listofexample
\listofremark
\listoftheorems
\tcblistof[\section*]{box}{Boxes}
\listoftodos
\listofalgorithms
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\example{A new example with \emph{italic}}
\remark{A new remark}
\begin{theorem}[New theorem]
The statement of the theorem.
\end{theorem}
\begin{mybox}{New box}
Text in the box.
\end{mybox}
\todo[inline]{New todo}
\begin{algorithm}
Step\;
\caption{New algorithm}
\end{algorithm}
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{New figure}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
\centering A table.
\caption{New table}
\end{table}
\begin{lstlisting}[caption={New listing}]
x = 1
\end{lstlisting}
\begin{program}[h]
\centering A program.
\caption{New program}
\end{program}
\section{Second}
Text of the second section.
\remark{Another new remark}
\end{document}
